messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Email and Cloud Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['Your account is suspended due to The Cornell WebMail major Terms are being changed.', 'Facebook Notification sent you a message.', 'Upgrade Or Your EDU Email Will Be Deactivated', 'All mailbox is undergoing regeneration to the new Microsoft Outlook web access 2013.', 'We will need you to confirm that your account is still in use.', 'If your (EDU) E-mail account has not being validated in the last five days of our web the latest IP Security upgrades please do verify it to avoid closure of your web account', 'Your AOL access will be blocked.', 'This is a courtesy notice from the Admin Team, and it is to inform you that your email account has exceeded its mail quota on the database server, which has caused some incoming mails to be placed on pending.', 'That means your AOL email address will stop working after 10th MAY 2020 unless you switch to AOL OATH.', 'Some of your important messages were queued on our mail server.', 'Your mailbox is almost full.', 'Attention: Your financial institution sent you a Secure Document using Google Documents.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
